items.title: pbakaus/impeccable
items.contentSnippet:
The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
https://impeccable.style

Impeccable
 
Design guidance for AI coding agents. 1 skill, 24 commands, live browser iteration, and 61 deterministic detector rules for AI-generated frontend design.
 
 
 
Quick start: From your project root, run npx impeccable install, then run /impeccable init inside your AI coding tool. Full docs: impeccable.style.
 
 
Why Impeccable?
 
Anthropic's frontend-design was the first widely-used design skill

items.title: Show HN: Mistis – a decoupled, E2EE protocol for mid-call user authentication
items.contentSnippet:
We have built an authentication protocol enabling mid-session real-time identity verification between final users during any active communication, delivered via a proprietary decoupled channel.
System allows users to send identity verification challenges to each other on-demand during communication. The goal is to prevent identity takeover by real-time audio deepfakes.
It is inspired in 3DS credit card processing –taking away the UX nightmare; some similarities: decoupled rail for authentication

items.title: Show HN: A complete web build of OrcaSlicer for 3D printing
items.contentSnippet:
Using a good deal of Claude, I got OrcaSlicer (and preFlight slicer) engines running in client-side WebAssembly with a full feature set for painting, slicing, assembling, and printing 3d models.
The UI is also mobile friendly for slicing on the go.
Direct print is supported for many models, though CORS proxying is often needed.
It also supports a minimal level of TinkerCAD-style CSG modeling, as well as importing models from https://cubbycad.com
